shared.distance: minimum Euclidean distance to retained training granular-ball centers

protocol_overrides.normalization: channel-wise z-score fitted on the official normal-only training prefix and applied unchanged to the full series
protocol_overrides.inference_centers: granular-ball centers recomputed from the normal-only training prefix after restoring the best validation state; never constructed from Eval samples
protocol_overrides.numeric_stability: clamp round-off-negative squared Euclidean distances to zero before sqrt; remove only a leading singleton reconstruction-target dimension that the released code broadcasts implicitly; discard empty KMeans clusters and cast non-empty membership indices to int64; treat a failed two-way split as unsplittable instead of duplicating the parent indefinitely; retain the largest support ball only if pruning would otherwise leave no center
protocol_overrides.metric_implementation: installed official TSB-AD get_metrics with pred=None
